deep.reconstruction: This page contains no mathematics. It is the cover or title sheet of a manuscript folder: ruled paper with a handwritten title, 'Zum Zahlbegriff.' ('On the concept of number'). At the top is a pasted library label: 'Auch als Mikroform vorhanden unter Sign.: MF Cod. Ms. Dedekind 3: 2' ('Also available as microform under shelfmark MF Cod. Ms. Dedekind 3:2'). At the lower left, on a small pasted slip, is the archival number 'III 2'. This places the bundle as Cod. Ms. Dedekind III.2 in the Dedekind Nachlass, which I believe is held at the SUB Göttingen. The title suggests the bundle holds material on the foundations of the number concept. Such material would relate to Dedekind's published work on the subject: 'Stetigkeit und irrationale Zahlen' (1872) and 'Was sind und was sollen die Zahlen?' (1888), with drafts going back to the 1870s. That link cannot be confirmed from this sheet alone. There are no derivations to reconstruct.
